idea-plugin.name: Jellybeans Theme Continued
idea-plugin.description:
A dark theme with warm, muted syntax colors inspired by Jellybeans for Vim.

Includes a matching editor color scheme and colors for IDE controls, tool windows, version control, and syntax highlighting. Select Jellybeans in Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Appearance | Theme.

Maintained continuation of the original Jellybeans IntelliJ theme by Zack A. (aurdevv), via sefidel/jellybeans-intellij. Source code and issue reports: GitHub.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.0.0: First release of the maintained continuation. Preserves the Jellybeans palette, updates plugin metadata and build tooling, and adds automated resource and compatibility checks.
